title: Malaysian Fried Noodle Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir-fry dish made with fried noodles, tofu, and malaysian spices.

ingredients.name: crisp
ingredients.notes: fry until golden brown for garnish

instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add tofu and stir-fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add fried noodles and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add Malaysian spice blend and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add crisp and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with additional crisp if desired.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
